source_policy: committed_current_runtime_pack_only; the BEFU26 annual source pack is repo-local; Streamlit does not load the offline workbooks or legacy Excel forecast paths
runtime_policy: Revenue Outlook runtime rows are materialized from repo-local source actuals, current finalist forecasts and the MBU26 official comparator. Source-pack tables are retained as audit lineage and are not a second Streamlit chart engine.

official_vintages.official_comparator_policy: Published official vintages are immutable by default. Current policy controls alter Current forecasts only; no official vintage receives a Current policy overlay by default.

runtime_source_layers.A_actuals: BEFU26 annual source rows through last complete FY2025
runtime_source_layers.B_official_comparator: Official comparator traces for every registered available vintage (BEFU26, MBU26); default BEFU26 published rows for FY2026+
runtime_source_layers.C_current_finalist_activity: Promoted quarterly finalist outputs annualized by June year
runtime_source_layers.D_hybrid_current_revenue: Only PED, Light RUC and Heavy RUC revenue are replaced; all other rows use BEFU26 official components.
runtime_source_layers.E_ev_phev_split_audit: Current finalist Light RUC is governed as a total light-RUC net-km model input. The optimized migration layer allocates BEV/PHEV uptake between PED/light-petrol and total Light RUC before revenue rates are applied.
runtime_source_layers.F_runtime_cutoff: No extrapolated model extension is used in the current Revenue Outlook runtime path; current-finalist comparisons stop at FY2030.

period_rule.horizon_scope_policy: Three horizon contracts. Current decision-facing Light RUC and every total that depends on it stop at H20/FY2030. The official comparator publishes over its own source horizon. Raw model and replay evidence keep their full source horizon as non-decision-facing audit.
period_rule.fy2026_nowcast: FY2026 mixes accepted actuals and forecasts per stream (PED: actuals through 2025Q4, forecasts from 2026Q1; LIGHT_RUC: actuals through 2026Q1, forecasts from 2026Q2; HEAVY_RUC: actuals through 2026Q1, forecasts from 2026Q2)
period_rule.rule: Actual line ends FY2025; FY2026 actual-to-date rows are nowcast inputs only and are not plotted as actuals. Current-finalist comparative charts and runtime calculations stop at FY2030, the last governed common non-extrapolated horizon.

PED.provisional_seed: provisional_annual_bridge seed available for 2026Q1 (method mbu26_residual_core_ped_share; ped_mode provisional_replay_only); not an observed actual and excluded from estimation

data_vintage_manifest_notes.runtime_cutoff: No extrapolated model extension is used beyond FY2030: the FY2051-FY2055 gradient extension is disabled and current-finalist paths stop where governed model and source assumptions stop. Last displayed/current calculation FY is FY2030. This is NOT a statement that the whole displayed path is validated. See forecast_horizon_validation for the three governed support states.
data_vintage_manifest_notes.forecast_horizon_validation: Model training cutoff 2025Q4. Three governed support states, exposed on every June-year row as horizon_zone/horizon_scope plus quarter counts (quarters_backtest_supported, quarters_extended_evidence, quarters_unvalidated): H1-H12 backtest-supported by the committed evidence pack; H13-H20 extended conditional evidence from artifacts/long_horizon_validation, thinner samples and not validated to the short-term standard; H21+ no extended evaluation evidence, unvalidated long-range extrapolation. FY2026-FY2028 are H1-H12; FY2029 mixes H1-H12 and H13-H20; FY2030 is entirely H13-H20; FY2031 mixes H13-H20 and H21+; FY2032 onward is entirely H21+.
data_vintage_manifest_notes.light_ruc_target_semantics: Business rule update: current-finalist Light RUC is treated as total light-RUC net km, while EV/PHEV migration is sourced from both current PED/light-petrol activity and total Light RUC using an optimized deterministic bridge calibrated to BEFU26 light-mobility proportions. BEV/PHEV are not fixed add-ons.
data_vintage_manifest_notes.ev_phev_migration_allocation: Default lambda_mode is optimized; alternatives are recorded for audit only and do not replace the current runtime path unless explicitly selected in governance review.
data_vintage_manifest_notes.scenario_role_contract: PED VKT per capita is a behavioural intensity metric. Value-changing comparison PED intensity is labelled as a behavioural comparison path; aggregate and revenue rows keep comparison traces.

source_comparison.output_dir_policy: Source run output folders are not published in the promoted runtime manifest; scenario roles, workbook hashes, and governed output hashes are retained.

scenario_role_validation.rule: exactly one basecase role and at least one comparison role; upload order is never used

join_key_contract.rule: Forecast Builder volume packs join to Revenue Outlook rows by canonical stream, period and scenario keys; historical rows use historical_actual.

MBU26.workbook_basename: Revenue forecast error, annual view from BEFU 2013-25.xlsx

mbu26_annual_spine.workbook_basename: Revenue forecast error, annual view from BEFU 2013-25.xlsx
Revenue forecast error, annual view from BEFU 2013-25.xlsx
mbu26_annual_spine.source_policy: MBU26 worksheet only; workbook is offline lineage and is never loaded at Streamlit runtime.
mbu26_annual_spine.formula_policy: MBU26 annual value cells are stored without Excel formulas in the grid; aggregate formula contracts are asserted from MBU26 row identities and residuals are reported without force-balancing.

revenue_source_pack.default_selection_policy: Revenue Outlook defaults to Total NLTF revenue from the BEFU26 source pack.

equations.EV_PHEV_MIGRATION: Optimized lambda allocates EV/PHEV uptake between PED/light-petrol and current finalist total Light RUC to match BEFU26 light-mobility proportions with a smoothness penalty.
equations.PED: PED revenue = adjusted PED/light-petrol VKT after optimized EV/PHEV migration * BEFU26 litres/100km * BEFU26 gross PED rate.
equations.LIGHT_RUC: Light RUC revenue = optimized conventional Light RUC km after EV/PHEV migration * BEFU26 conventional Light effective rate.
equations.HEAVY_RUC: Heavy RUC revenue = current finalist net km * BEFU26 effective Heavy RUC rate.
equations.ROLLUPS: Gross FED, Net FED, Total RUC, Total RUC+PED and Total NLTF recalculate optimized PED, conventional Light RUC, Light BEV, PHEV and Heavy RUC replacement lines plus BEFU26 fixed components.

LIGHT_RUC.decision: Allocate EV/PHEV uptake between PED/light-petrol activity and current-finalist total Light RUC using the optimized migration layer; retain the legacy Light-only split as an audit comparator.
LIGHT_RUC.rationale: The current governed business rule sources EV/PHEV migration from both PED/light-petrol activity and total Light RUC. The legacy split audit preserves prior model-input target evidence and old Light-only comparators for review.

HEAVY_RUC.decision: Heavy BEV remains an MBU26 fixed component in current-finalist paths.
HEAVY_RUC.rationale: No repo-local evidence in this audit proves the Heavy RUC target includes Heavy BEV.

ev_phev_split_assumptions.scope: Legacy continuity audit for MBU26 conventional Light, Light BEV and PHEV km/revenue shares and rates, with old fixed-add-on comparator fields. The active current path is the PED+Light migration audit.

ev_phev_ped_light_drift_assumptions.scope: Deterministic EV/PHEV migration bridge over current PED/light-petrol activity and current finalist total Light RUC, including optimized, Light-only, PED-only and MBU-ratio lambda modes.

ped_revenue_bridge_audit.scope: Current-finalist PED bridge decomposition by FY/source path: VKTpc, scenario population, raw VKTpc x population, optimized EV/PHEV migration VKT, PED volume/revenue, Total NLTF, MBU26 comparators and fallback flags.

ped_bridge_shape_fit_metrics.scope: FY2026-FY2050 raw-vs-optimized PED bridge shape-fit metrics against MBU26 comparators.

ped_bridge_mode_config.scope: Audit bridge modes for raw, blend and optimized PED bridge overlays. Raw is the default runtime mode.

ped_efficiency_scenarios.scope: Governed PED fleet-efficiency sensitivity over litres per 100km after EV/PHEV migration.
ped_efficiency_scenarios.note: Efficiency sensitivity reduces litres per 100km after EV/PHEV migration; it does not change VKTpc forecasts.

sensitivity_seed_inputs.scope: Compact Inputs (TI) seed values for fleet efficiency, PT mode shift and demand elasticity, plus analyst-inferred freight rail shift presets (no official MoT freight-shift scenario exists).
sensitivity_seed_inputs.excluded_scope: Fleet transition, crude/oil shock, crude-to-pump and ETS/margin/tax pass-through are not runtime sensitivities.

sensitivity_config.scope: Low-complexity post-model Revenue Outlook overlays: fleet efficiency, PT mode shift, freight rail shift (analyst-inferred presets) and optional demand elasticity.
sensitivity_config.note: Post-model overlays; default Off preserves model forecast. Scenario workbook price variables are already captured by finalist forecasts where supplied.

sensitivity_impact_audit.scope: Default-Off sensitivity audit; runtime UI recalculates selected impacts in memory.

scenario_role_contract.scope: Repo-local audit of scenario role semantics, PED population-feature exposure, display policy and runtime deltas.

scenario_input_delta_audit.scope: Workbook-cell base/comparison deltas derived from committed scenario_input_long artifacts, including source cells, workbook hashes, scenario roles and variable classifications.

scenario_input_replay_mismatch_report.scope: Verification that promoted current-finalist activity rows map back to committed scenario-input quarters and workbook hashes before annual Revenue Outlook rows are emitted.
scenario_input_replay_mismatch_report.fail_policy: If any required scenario-input quarter is missing or hash-mismatched, rebuild writes this report and raises.

scenario_feature_lineage.scope: Feature-level lineage from committed scenario input artifacts to fixed finalist forecast variables.

rate_provenance.future_light_heavy: befu26 pack official-annual effective rates joined to current finalist net-km outputs
rate_provenance.future_ped: Scenario-input population where supplied plus BEFU26 intensity/rate joined to optimized PED/light-petrol VKT after EV/PHEV migration
rate_provenance.fixed_components: befu26 pack official-annual rows, excluding Light BEV and PHEV in current-finalist paths where they are allocated by the optimized PED+Light migration layer

trace_audit.scope: Per-series FY2024-FY2027 trace audit with source, role, model ID, scenario, quarter composition and anchor flags.

runtime_cutoff_audit.horizon_scope_policy: Three horizon contracts. Current decision-facing Light RUC and every total that depends on it stop at H20/FY2030. The official comparator publishes over its own source horizon. Raw model and replay evidence keep their full source horizon as non-decision-facing audit.
runtime_cutoff_audit.scope: Dynamic Revenue Outlook runtime cutoff audit from current Base, current comparison and required BEFU26 input horizons.

revenue_line_reconciliation.scope: Live table source for official-vintage and current finalist line-item decomposition.

revenue_formula_residuals.scope: Formula residual checks for RUC, FED, MVR and total rows by source path and FY.

revenue_stack_components.scope: Composition-over-time stack rows classified from revenue_line_reconciliation in gross-to-net bridge and gross-contribution modes; aggregates are overlays only and are never stacked.
revenue_stack_components.balance_rule: Gross-to-net bridge reconciles displayed stack_value to Total NLTF revenue; gross contribution stack reconciles displayed stack_value to Total gross revenues. Residuals are reported and never forced.

series_alias_audit.scope: Canonical Revenue Outlook series aliases from source labels/series IDs to dashboard selector IDs.

fan_availability.scope: Per-series availability contract for Revenue Outlook fan sources, missing artifacts and interpretation.

fan_band_rows.scope: Hash-backed fan band rows only where archived-error, current-finalist backtest or scenario-spread evidence exists.
